confirmedRemainingWork: 71 indexed paper components currently have no Mark Bank cards. The other 20 also need full independent task and selection review; generated counts are not coverage proof.

2022 and 2024 HL Paper 2 Q2A(a) omit the An Lasair Choille alternative after the first Cáca Milis tariff. Q2B(a) also omits its alternative drama route. Paper page 8 visually reviewed for both years; 2022 Q2B(a) continues on page 9 and still needs visual/scheme verification.
2022 HL Paper 2 Q3B(a)(i), paper page 12, prints a closed choice among images, contrast and emotions. It needs three explicit routes and its complete shared marking treatment.

The current card and deck types support only higher/ordinary. MarkBank profileDeckChoice wrongly maps Foundation profile labels to Higher. Foundation requires proper types, deck loading, persisted selection and level labels before its cards can be used.

Topic Atlas currently has 979 coarse physical/question anchors. This is not proof of parity with every independently practicable Mark Bank task. Reconcile exact parts/topics and preserve existing Atlas entries.
Irish 2010 HL/OL and 2011 Foundation have papers but no indexed marking scheme (eight paper components). Find authoritative schemes rather than inventing marks.

Listening recordings must be verified for each year and level; Foundation uses different recordings. Preserve passages, poems, signs, forms and picture sequences using the existing open/close source reader.
Full visual paper/scheme sweeps, raw selection-directive classification, preservation and zero-open/zero-orphan checks remain required before any completion claim or coverage-baseline change.
